tools.name: list_channels
tools.title: List channels
tools.description: List all connected social media channels (X/Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, TikTok, etc.). Returns channel ID, platform, account name, and token status, plus a `capabilities` object saying whether the caller may create, publish or approve posts. Check that before attempting a write rather than discovering the permission from a 403. Use this when the user wants to see which social accounts are connected.

active.description: Filter by active status. Defaults to true (only active channels).

capabilities.description: Whether the caller may create, publish or approve posts.

tools.name: create_post
tools.title: Create post
tools.description: Create a new social media post. Can be saved as a draft or scheduled for a specific time. Supports platform-specific content overrides, media attachments, labels, and thread format. IMPORTANT: YouTube and TikTok REQUIRE video — do not include them when posting images only. Instagram defaults to feed_photo — set postTypeOverrides for video content (reel, feed_video). Use this when the user wants to draft or schedule one new post. It never publishes immediately; publish_post does that.

content.description: The post text content. Optional — defaults to empty for media-only posts. LinkedIn mentions: write @[Display Name](urn:li:organization:ID) for a Page or @[Display Name](urn:li:person:ID) for a person; The token publishes as a real mention on LinkedIn and as plain @Display Name on other channels.

platform.description: Platform name. One of the supported BulkPublish platforms.

channels.description: Array of channels to post to. Get channel IDs from list_channels.

scheduledAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime for scheduling (e.g. 2025-01-15T10:00:00Z). Required when status is scheduled.

timezone.description: Timezone for scheduling (e.g. "America/New_York"). Defaults to UTC.

mediaFileIds.description: Array of media file IDs to attach. Upload media first with upload_media.

labels.description: Array of label IDs to tag the post with.

platformSpecific.description: Platform-specific settings, e.g. { "youtube": { "title": "…", "privacyStatus": "public" } }. Discord, Telegram, Tumblr and Snapchat nest their options under the BulkPublish channel id, e.g. { "discord": { "12": { "channelId": "1090123456789012345" } } }. Full per-platform option lists (polls, quotes, tags, drafts, settings) are on each platform key; bad values are refused with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

containsSyntheticMedia.description: true discloses realistic altered or synthetic content. Video and short posts.

notifySubscribers.description: Only an explicit false changes anything: publishes without notifying subscribers.

license.description: Default youtube; creativeCommon publishes under Creative Commons Attribution.

embeddable.description: false stops other websites embedding the video.

publicStatsViewable.description: false hides extended statistics on the watch page.

defaultLanguage.description: Language of the title and description, e.g. 'en', 'pt-BR', 'zh-Hans'.

defaultAudioLanguage.description: Language spoken in the video, e.g. 'en'.

recordingDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO 8601 date-time; a plain date is stored as midnight UTC.

coverImageUrl.description: Cover image URL for video pins. Optional — server falls back to an attached image, then the video's auto-extracted poster frame.

boardSectionId.description: Numeric ID of a section of the chosen board. Send it beside its board, per channel or flat. Pin, video_pin and carousel. A flat value is ignored for a channel with its own boardId, and any section is ignored when no board was chosen.

coverKeyFrameTime.description: video_pin only: use the frame at this many seconds (whole number, 0 or more) as the cover. A time past the end uses the last frame; coverImageUrl wins when both are sent.

thumbnailTimestamp.description: Cover frame for the video, in seconds from the start.

sendToDrafts.description: Send a video or photo_slideshow post to the creator's TikTok drafts instead of publishing it (default false). privacyLevel is then not required, and the direct-post settings (privacyLevel, disableDuet, disableStitch, disableComment, isAigc, brandContentToggle, brandOrganicToggle, autoAddMusic, thumbnailTimestamp) are ignored. A video draft carries no caption; a photo draft sends it. Once delivered the destination becomes published with no platformUrl; if the creator posts it within about a week, platformPostId becomes the video id, platformUrl is filled in and analytics are collected.

photoCoverIndex.description: photo_slideshow only: which image is the cover, a whole number 0 to 34 counting from 0 in attachment order (default 0). An index past the last image falls back to the first.

autoAddMusic.description: Photo posts published directly only: lets TikTok add a recommended track (default false). Ignored with sendToDrafts.

replySettings.description: Who can reply: everyone, following, verified, subscribers or mentionedUsers. Applies to a single post and to the first post of a thread.

repostId.description: With postTypeOverrides.x = 'repost': the X post URL or ID to repost (retweet).

poll.description: Adds a poll. Cannot be combined with media or quoteId. On a thread it goes on the first post.

durationMinutes.description: How long the poll stays open, whole minutes from 5 to 10080 (7 days).

quoteId.description: The post to quote: its numeric ID or its x.com / twitter.com status URL. Cannot be combined with poll. On a thread it applies to the first post.

communityId.description: Posts into an X Community: its numeric ID or its https://x.com/i/communities/<id> URL. The account must be a member.

shareWithFollowers.description: With communityId, also shows the post to your followers (default false). Ignored without communityId.

textFormatPresetId.description: Digits only (a Facebook background ID). Shows a short text post on a coloured background. Used only on a Page feed post with no photo, video or link card and at most 130 characters; anywhere else it is left out and the post publishes as plain text. If Facebook refuses the background the post is published once more without it.

thumbnailUrl.description: Cover image URL for a video or Reel. Facebook only accepts a cover once the video exists, so it is applied after the video publishes and appears a moment after the post; a cover that cannot be fetched or that Facebook rejects leaves the video published with Facebook's own chosen frame rather than failing the post.

collaborators.description: Comma-separated Instagram usernames (no leading @) tagged as co-authors. Applies with postTypeOverrides.instagram of 'feed_photo', 'feed_video', 'reel' or 'carousel' — on a carousel the co-authors are set on the carousel itself, not on its individual items. Ignored on 'story', which has no co-author concept.

userTags.description: People tagged in the post, up to 20 per photo or video. On a photo (and each photo of a carousel) a tag needs x and y or it is left out; on a Reel or video post people are tagged by username only and any position is ignored. Carousel videos and Stories carry no tags.

username.description: A public Instagram username, leading @ optional.

x.description: Position on the photo, 0 to 1 from the left. Give x and y together or not at all.

y.description: Position on the photo, 0 to 1 from the top.

mediaIndex.description: Which attached media item the tag belongs to, counting from 0 in attachment order (default 0).

shareToFeed.description: Reels only. false shows the Reel only in the Reels tab; true also shows it in the main feed. Omitted: Instagram's own default (feed and Reels tab).

locationId.description: Digits only: the numeric ID of a Facebook Page that has a location. Applies to photos, videos, Reels and carousels, not Stories. Instagram refuses the post if it does not recognise the ID as a place.

trialReel.description: Publish as a trial reel, shown to people who do not follow the account first. Only takes effect with postTypeOverrides.instagram of 'reel' — a 'feed_video' publishes as an ordinary reel and this is ignored, even though both use the same underlying reel container.

graduationStrategy.description: How a trial reel becomes a normal one: 'manual' (the creator releases it) or 'auto' (released automatically if it performs well). Default 'manual'. Ignored unless trialReel is true.

thumbnailTimestamp.description: Cover frame for a video or Reel, in seconds from the start. Applies to postTypeOverrides.instagram of 'feed_video' or 'reel'. Ignored when coverUrl is also set.

coverUrl.description: Cover image URL for a video or Reel. Takes precedence over thumbnailTimestamp: Instagram accepts one or the other and rejects a request carrying both, so only this one is forwarded when both are sent.

repostId.description: With postTypeOverrides.threads = 'repost': the numeric ID of the Threads post to repost (Threads links cannot be used; the ID of a post published through BulkPublish is in get_post's platforms[].platformPostId).

topicTag.description: One topic tag for the post, without a leading '#'. Must not contain periods or ampersands.

locationId.description: Numeric Threads place ID. Only works once the channel has granted location tagging.

replyControl.description: Who can reply (default everyone). parent_post_author_only means only you. Applies to the post itself, never to later replies in a thread; ignored on a repost.

pollOptions.description: 2 to 4 poll choices, each 1 to 25 characters. Text-only posts: on an image, video or carousel post the poll is left out. In a thread it goes on the first part when that part has no media.

linkAttachment.description: An http(s) URL on a public host shown as the preview card on a text post; left out on other post types. Threads refuses a post with more than 5 links in total, and a link here that differs from every link in the text counts as one more.

documentTitle.description: `document` posts only: the title shown above the document in the feed. Defaults to the file's name.

poll.description: Required for `poll` posts, which also need post text and take no media.

options.description: 2 to 4 answers, each up to 30 characters; blank entries are ignored.

reshareId.description: Required for `reshare` posts: the post's LinkedIn link, or its urn:li:share:<id> / urn:li:ugcPost:<id> ID. Activity links (urn:li:activity:<id>) cannot be reshared.

thumbnailUrl.description: Cover for a `post` that carries a video: a public http(s) link to an image of up to 10MB. A cover that cannot be fetched is skipped and LinkedIn picks the frame.

visibility.description: Who can see the post (default PUBLIC). CONNECTIONS applies to personal profiles only; on a Page it is published as PUBLIC.

disableReshare.description: true stops other members resharing the post (default false).

repostId.description: With postTypeOverrides.bluesky = 'repost': the bsky.app post URL (or at:// URI) to repost.

replyAllow.description: Who can reply. Omitted or [] means everyone; otherwise ['nobody'] or any mix of mention, following, follower ('nobody' cannot be combined). Set right after the post publishes; if Bluesky refuses it the post stays published without it. First post of a thread.

allowQuotes.description: false stops other accounts quoting the post (default true). Set right after publishing, like replyAllow.

quoteId.description: The post to quote: a bsky.app post link or an at:// URI (a bare ID is read as one of your own posts). Replaces a link card; with media attached both appear together. Publishing fails before anything is posted if the post cannot be found.

langs.description: Up to 3 language codes such as 'en' or 'pt-BR'. Applies to every part of a thread.

contentLabel.description: Adds a content warning. Applies to every part of a thread.

repostId.description: With postTypeOverrides.mastodon = 'repost': the status URL or ID to boost.

poll.description: Adds a poll. Cannot be combined with media. First post of a thread. A server with tighter limits refuses it at publish time.

expiresIn.description: Seconds the poll stays open, 300 to 2629746.

multiple.description: Voters may pick more than one choice (default false).

hideTotals.description: Hide counts until the poll ends (default false).

sensitive.description: Hides attached media behind a click (default false). No effect without media. Applies to every part of a thread.

quoteId.description: The post to quote: its URL, or its status ID on your own server. Needs a server running Mastodon 4.5 or later, otherwise publishing fails and nothing is posted.

discord.description: Discord options, nested under the BulkPublish channel id: { "12": { "channelId": "1090123456789012345" } }. A flat object applies to every Discord channel on the post. The inner channelId is the target Discord text channel. Posting uses a global bot token, so failures are permission problems, never a reconnect issue.

channelId.description: Required. Target Discord text channel id (a snowflake) inside the connected server. NOT the BulkPublish channel id used as the outer key.

startThread.description: Start a thread from the message (no effect on a forum channel).

threadName.description: Name for that thread, up to 100 characters.

embed.description: Send the text as a rich embed with the first image inside.

poll.description: A native poll. The bot needs the Send Polls permission.

answers.description: 2 to 10 answers, each up to 55 characters.

pin.description: Pin the message. If Discord refuses, the post stays published and a warning is recorded. The bot needs the Pin Messages permission.

tags.description: Up to 5 forum tag IDs (digits) for a forum channel.

tags.description: Up to 5 forum tag IDs (digits) for a forum channel.

telegram.description: Telegram options, nested under the BulkPublish channel id: { "12": { "silent": true } }. A flat object applies to every Telegram channel on the post. The destination chat is fixed when the channel is connected. Content is sent as plain text (no markdown). Text over the 1024-char caption limit is posted as a second message alongside captionless media. Attached GIFs, audio and other files are sent as an animation, an audio file or a document according to their type.

protectContent.description: Recipients cannot forward or save the message.

pin.description: Pin after sending. If the bot lacks the right to pin the post still publishes and a warning is recorded.

threadId.description: Forum topic to post into: digits only, up to 12.

buttons.description: Link buttons under the message, up to 3.

spoiler.description: Hides a photo or video behind a spoiler.

poll.description: Sent as a poll after the message.

options.description: 2 to 12 answers, each up to 100 characters.

multipleAnswers.description: Default false. Cannot be combined with quiz.

correctOption.description: 0-based index of the right answer; required when quiz is true.

protectContent.description: Recipients cannot forward or save the message.

pin.description: Pin after sending. If the bot lacks the right to pin the post still publishes and a warning is recorded.

threadId.description: Forum topic to post into: digits only, up to 12.

buttons.description: Link buttons under the message, up to 3.

spoiler.description: Hides a photo or video behind a spoiler.

poll.description: Sent as a poll after the message.

options.description: 2 to 12 answers, each up to 100 characters.

multipleAnswers.description: Default false. Cannot be combined with quiz.

correctOption.description: 0-based index of the right answer; required when quiz is true.

tumblr.description: Tumblr options, nested under the BulkPublish channel id: { "12": { "blogName": "myblog", "tags": ["art"] } } (tags: array of strings or one comma-separated string). A flat object applies to every Tumblr channel on the post. Up to 30 images OR exactly one video per post.

blogName.description: Which blog to publish to. Defaults to the blog the channel was connected as.

title.description: Rendered as a heading block above the body.

sourceUrl.description: Attribution URL stored as the post's source.

state.description: Default published. A scheduled post with published still goes out at its time; draft and private override that and the post is never made public by BulkPublish.

slug.description: Up to 200 characters; lowercased and hyphenated into the permalink.

reblogUrl.description: A Tumblr post link (tumblr.com/<blog>/<id> or <blog>.tumblr.com/post/<id>): publishes a reblog of that post with your text as the comment.

blogName.description: Which blog to publish to. Defaults to the blog the channel was connected as.

title.description: Rendered as a heading block above the body.

sourceUrl.description: Attribution URL stored as the post's source.

state.description: Default published. A scheduled post with published still goes out at its time; draft and private override that and the post is never made public by BulkPublish.

slug.description: Up to 200 characters; lowercased and hyphenated into the permalink.

reblogUrl.description: A Tumblr post link (tumblr.com/<blog>/<id> or <blog>.tumblr.com/post/<id>): publishes a reblog of that post with your text as the comment.

snapchat.description: Snapchat options, nested under the BulkPublish channel id: { "12": { "title": "My story" } }. A flat object applies to every Snapchat channel on the post. Post types: story (default), saved_story, spotlight. Every Snapchat post requires exactly ONE image or video (vertical, story videos 5–60s, spotlight 6–60s video-only, saved_story videos not length-checked, max 1GB; a video outside its range is refused when the post is scheduled or published). The caption is NOT sent for plain stories — it is only the Spotlight description (160 chars max) and the Saved Story title fallback. First comments are not supported.

title.description: Saved Story title (max 45 chars). Defaults to the first line of the caption, truncated.

saveToProfile.description: Spotlight only. Default true; false sends skip_save_to_profile to Snap.

title.description: Saved Story title (max 45 chars). Defaults to the first line of the caption, truncated.

saveToProfile.description: Spotlight only. Default true; false sends skip_save_to_profile to Snap.

platformContent.description: Per-platform content overrides, e.g. { "x": "Short tweet", "linkedin": "Longer LinkedIn post" }.

postFormat.description: Post format. "post" (default), "video", "reel", "story", "carousel", or "thread" for multi-part threads.

threadParts.description: Thread parts array. Required when postFormat is thread (min 2 parts). EVERY part is measured against the character limit of every platform the post targets, not only the first — an over-long part is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR naming the part number, the platform and its limit. URLs count as 23 characters on X and Mastodon, their real length elsewhere.

mediaFileIds.description: Media files for this thread part.

postTypeOverrides.description: Per-platform post type override. E.g. { "instagram": "reel", "youtube": "short" }. Video length is checked per type when the post is scheduled or published, and a video outside the range is refused: instagram reel/feed_video 3s–15min, story 3–60s; facebook reel 3–90s, story 3–60s; threads video/carousel up to 5min; linkedin 3s–30min; pinterest video_pin at least 4s; snapchat story 5–60s, spotlight 6–60s (saved_story not checked).

linkedin.description: document: one PDF, Word or PowerPoint file from the media library (exactly one document, no images or videos; title from platformSpecific.linkedin.documentTitle). poll: a question with 2-4 answers from platformSpecific.linkedin.poll (needs post text, no media). reshare: shares an existing LinkedIn post from platformSpecific.linkedin.reshareId (post text optional, no media).

snapchat.description: story (default): 1 image or video, caption NOT sent. saved_story: 1 image or video with a title. spotlight: video only, 6–60s, caption becomes the description. Story videos must be 5–60s; a video outside its range is refused when the post is scheduled or published. saved_story video length is not checked.

requestApproval.description: Optional (default false). Set true to hold a scheduled post for team approval (approvalStatus becomes 'pending'). Forced on server-side for API keys of roles without post:publish (contributors), regardless of this flag.

publishWhenApproved.description: Optional (default false). Set true on a post that waits for approval when it should go out as soon as it is approved, even if that is after its scheduled time. This is how someone who needs approval says 'publish now': status 'scheduled', scheduledAt = now, requestApproval true (or a contributor key), publishWhenApproved true. An approval arriving more than 15 minutes late then publishes immediately; with false it is approved but returned to draft for a new time. Stored only when the post ends up approvalStatus 'pending'; otherwise saved as false.

linkTrackingOverride.description: Optional per-post override for link tracking (bulkpubli.sh). true forces links in this post to be shortened and their clicks counted, false forces them to publish as written, and null/omitted (the default) inherits the organization's Link Tracking setting. Shortening happens at publish time, per channel, so two accounts on the same platform get distinct codes; it is skipped for a channel when the rewrite would push the post past that platform's character limit (a short URL is 28 characters and can be longer than the link it replaces). Short links are part of the Pro and Business plans: on Free, links always publish as written and true has no effect.

status.description: draft, scheduled, processing, published, partial or failed.

author.description: Who wrote the post: { id, name, image }. Null when that account is gone.

approver.description: Who approved it: { id, name, image }. Null unless approvalStatus is approved.

assignee.description: Who is expected to act on it next: { id, name, image }. Null when nobody is.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.title: List posts
tools.description: List posts with optional filters for status, search text, date range, channel, and label. Returns paginated results with platform statuses and metrics, ordered newest-first by publishedAt if the post is live, else scheduledAt, else createdAt. Use this when the user wants to browse, filter, or check the status of existing posts as raw data (not the visual dashboard).

from.description: Filter posts created on or after this ISO date.

to.description: Filter posts created on or before this ISO date.

scheduledFrom.description: Filter posts scheduled on or after this ISO date.

scheduledTo.description: Filter posts scheduled on or before this ISO date.

approvalStatus.description: Filter by team approval state (e.g. 'pending' for the approval queue).

assignedTo.description: Filter by who the post is assigned to: a user id, 'me' for the caller, or 'unassigned'. Orthogonal to status — a post can be scheduled AND assigned.

order.description: Direction of the timeline sort (published, else due, else created). 'desc' is the default and returns the most recent first. Use 'asc' to read what is coming NEXT — with a limit, 'desc' returns the posts scheduled furthest out, not the soonest.

status.description: draft, scheduled, processing, published, partial or failed.

author.description: Who wrote the post: { id, name, image }. Null when that account is gone.

approver.description: Who approved it: { id, name, image }. Null unless approvalStatus is approved.

assignee.description: Who is expected to act on it next: { id, name, image }. Null when nobody is.

tools.name: get_post
tools.title: Get post
tools.description: Get a single post by ID with full details including platform statuses, labels, media files, recurring schedule info, and metrics. For a thread post, `threadParts` holds the parts and `threadMediaFiles` resolves the media they reference: that media is NOT in `mediaFiles`, which carries only the media on the post itself. Use this when the user references one specific post by its ID.

status.description: draft, scheduled, processing, published, partial or failed.

author.description: Who wrote the post: { id, name, image }. Null when that account is gone.

approver.description: Who approved it: { id, name, image }. Null unless approvalStatus is approved.

assignee.description: Who is expected to act on it next: { id, name, image }. Null when nobody is.

tools.name: publish_post
tools.title: Publish post now
tools.description: Publish a draft or scheduled post immediately. The post will be queued for publishing to all its target channels. Requires a role with post:publish — contributors get 403 APPROVAL_REQUIRED and must submit the post for approval instead (create/update with requestApproval, then a teammate approves). To 'publish now' with approval, create_post with status 'scheduled', scheduledAt = now, requestApproval true and publishWhenApproved true, so it goes out the moment it is approved. Publishing a pending/rejected post as an approver implicitly approves it. Use this when the user wants to publish an existing draft or scheduled post right now.

status.description: draft, scheduled, processing, published, partial or failed.

author.description: Who wrote the post: { id, name, image }. Null when that account is gone.

approver.description: Who approved it: { id, name, image }. Null unless approvalStatus is approved.

assignee.description: Who is expected to act on it next: { id, name, image }. Null when nobody is.

tools.name: retry_post
tools.title: Retry failed post
tools.description: Retry publishing a failed or partially failed post. Only retries the platforms that failed, not the ones that already succeeded. Platforms in status 'unconfirmed' (the publish request may have reached the platform but its response was lost — the post may already be live) are NOT retried unless republish is true; if the post has unconfirmed platforms and no failed ones, the call fails with a 400 and code UNCONFIRMED_REQUIRES_REPUBLISH — ask the user to check the account on the platform, and only pass republish: true after they confirm the post is not live. Use this when a post failed on some platforms and the user wants to retry just those.

republish.description: Explicit opt-in to also retry platforms in status 'unconfirmed'. Their publish may have already gone through, so this can DUPLICATE the post — only pass true after the user has checked the account and confirmed the post is not live. Defaults to false.

status.description: draft, scheduled, processing, published, partial or failed.

author.description: Who wrote the post: { id, name, image }. Null when that account is gone.

approver.description: Who approved it: { id, name, image }. Null unless approvalStatus is approved.

assignee.description: Who is expected to act on it next: { id, name, image }. Null when nobody is.

skippedMaxRetries.description: Destinations skipped for hitting the retry ceiling.

tools.name: upload_media
tools.title: Upload media
tools.description: Upload a media file (image, video or document) from a URL or local file path. The file is stored in BulkPublish for use in posts. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, MOV, WebM, and documents (PDF, Word .doc/.docx, PowerPoint .ppt/.pptx). Max 100MB. A document has no thumbnail or preview and can only be published to LinkedIn, as a `document` post. Provide either url OR filePath, not both. Use this when the user provides an image, video or document to attach to a post.

url.description: Public URL of the media file to upload.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a local file to upload (e.g. /Users/me/photo.png).

filename.description: Optional filename. If omitted, derived from the URL or file path.

file.description: A file provided by the chat host. Leave unset and use url otherwise.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file.

tools.name: list_media
tools.title: List media
tools.description: List uploaded media files with optional search and pagination. Returns file metadata including URLs, dimensions, and labels. Use this when the user wants a list of their uploaded media files.

type.description: Filter by media kind: image, video or document (PDF, Word and PowerPoint files). Omit for all files. The response's `total` counts matches across all pages.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.title: Get analytics
tools.description: Get an analytics summary for a date range. Returns total posts, status breakdown (published, failed, scheduled), per-platform stats, and daily post counts. Optional filters narrow every figure to matching posts; `compare` adds the equal-length previous window under `previous` (available for windows of 15 days or fewer — the 30-day statistics-retention cap applies). Use this when the user asks how their content performed overall, across channels and over a date range.

channelIds.description: Comma-separated channel ids to include, e.g. "12,15".

platforms.description: Comma-separated platform keys to include, e.g. "x,linkedin".

labelIds.description: Comma-separated label ids; a post matches when it carries ANY of them.

postFormat.description: Only single posts or only threads.

mediaType.description: By the post's first media file: text (no media), image or video.

compare.description: Also return the previous equal-length window as `previous` / `previousWindow`.

tz.description: IANA timezone (e.g. "Asia/Karachi") that sets where each day starts and ends and how daily counts are grouped. Defaults to UTC; pass the user's zone so 'today' and daily figures match their calendar.

tools.name: update_post
tools.title: Update post
tools.description: Update an existing post. Can change content, schedule, media, labels, status, and platform-specific settings. Only draft, scheduled, failed, or partial posts can be edited; editing a failed post resets it to draft, a partial post stays partial. Set status to 'draft' or 'scheduled' to move the post between those states — scheduling a partial post re-queues only its failed channels; use publish_post to publish immediately. Use this when the user wants to edit an existing post.

status.description: Move the post between draft and scheduled. 'scheduled' requires a future scheduledAt (in this call or already stored) and at least one channel; 'draft' unschedules it. Any other value is rejected. Omit to leave the status unchanged. To publish immediately, use publish_post instead.

labelIds.description: Replace label IDs on the post.

postTypeOverrides.description: Per-platform post type override. E.g. { "instagram": "reel", "youtube": "short" }. Video length is checked per type when the post is scheduled or published, and a video outside the range is refused: instagram reel/feed_video 3s–15min, story 3–60s; facebook reel 3–90s, story 3–60s; threads video/carousel up to 5min; linkedin 3s–30min; pinterest video_pin at least 4s; snapchat story 5–60s, spotlight 6–60s (saved_story not checked).

linkedin.description: document: one PDF, Word or PowerPoint file from the media library (exactly one document, no images or videos; title from platformSpecific.linkedin.documentTitle). poll: a question with 2-4 answers from platformSpecific.linkedin.poll (needs post text, no media). reshare: shares an existing LinkedIn post from platformSpecific.linkedin.reshareId (post text optional, no media).

snapchat.description: story (default): 1 image or video, caption NOT sent. saved_story: 1 image or video with a title. spotlight: video only, 6–60s, caption becomes the description. Story videos must be 5–60s; a video outside its range is refused when the post is scheduled or published. saved_story video length is not checked.

platformSpecific.description: Platform-specific settings, e.g. { "youtube": { "title": "…", "privacyStatus": "public" } }. Discord, Telegram, Tumblr and Snapchat nest their options under the BulkPublish channel id, e.g. { "discord": { "12": { "channelId": "1090123456789012345" } } }. Full per-platform option lists (polls, quotes, tags, drafts, settings) are on each platform key; bad values are refused with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

containsSyntheticMedia.description: true discloses realistic altered or synthetic content. Video and short posts.

notifySubscribers.description: Only an explicit false changes anything: publishes without notifying subscribers.

license.description: Default youtube; creativeCommon publishes under Creative Commons Attribution.

embeddable.description: false stops other websites embedding the video.

publicStatsViewable.description: false hides extended statistics on the watch page.

defaultLanguage.description: Language of the title and description, e.g. 'en', 'pt-BR', 'zh-Hans'.

defaultAudioLanguage.description: Language spoken in the video, e.g. 'en'.

recordingDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO 8601 date-time; a plain date is stored as midnight UTC.

coverImageUrl.description: Cover image URL for video pins. Optional — server falls back to an attached image, then the video's auto-extracted poster frame.

boardSectionId.description: Numeric ID of a section of the chosen board. Send it beside its board, per channel or flat. Pin, video_pin and carousel. A flat value is ignored for a channel with its own boardId, and any section is ignored when no board was chosen.

coverKeyFrameTime.description: video_pin only: use the frame at this many seconds (whole number, 0 or more) as the cover. A time past the end uses the last frame; coverImageUrl wins when both are sent.

thumbnailTimestamp.description: Cover frame for the video, in seconds from the start.

sendToDrafts.description: Send a video or photo_slideshow post to the creator's TikTok drafts instead of publishing it (default false). privacyLevel is then not required, and the direct-post settings (privacyLevel, disableDuet, disableStitch, disableComment, isAigc, brandContentToggle, brandOrganicToggle, autoAddMusic, thumbnailTimestamp) are ignored. A video draft carries no caption; a photo draft sends it. Once delivered the destination becomes published with no platformUrl; if the creator posts it within about a week, platformPostId becomes the video id, platformUrl is filled in and analytics are collected.

photoCoverIndex.description: photo_slideshow only: which image is the cover, a whole number 0 to 34 counting from 0 in attachment order (default 0). An index past the last image falls back to the first.

autoAddMusic.description: Photo posts published directly only: lets TikTok add a recommended track (default false). Ignored with sendToDrafts.

replySettings.description: Who can reply: everyone, following, verified, subscribers or mentionedUsers. Applies to a single post and to the first post of a thread.

repostId.description: With postTypeOverrides.x = 'repost': the X post URL or ID to repost (retweet).

poll.description: Adds a poll. Cannot be combined with media or quoteId. On a thread it goes on the first post.

durationMinutes.description: How long the poll stays open, whole minutes from 5 to 10080 (7 days).

quoteId.description: The post to quote: its numeric ID or its x.com / twitter.com status URL. Cannot be combined with poll. On a thread it applies to the first post.

communityId.description: Posts into an X Community: its numeric ID or its https://x.com/i/communities/<id> URL. The account must be a member.

shareWithFollowers.description: With communityId, also shows the post to your followers (default false). Ignored without communityId.

textFormatPresetId.description: Digits only (a Facebook background ID). Shows a short text post on a coloured background. Used only on a Page feed post with no photo, video or link card and at most 130 characters; anywhere else it is left out and the post publishes as plain text. If Facebook refuses the background the post is published once more without it.

thumbnailUrl.description: Cover image URL for a video or Reel. Facebook only accepts a cover once the video exists, so it is applied after the video publishes and appears a moment after the post; a cover that cannot be fetched or that Facebook rejects leaves the video published with Facebook's own chosen frame rather than failing the post.

collaborators.description: Comma-separated Instagram usernames (no leading @) tagged as co-authors. Applies with postTypeOverrides.instagram of 'feed_photo', 'feed_video', 'reel' or 'carousel' — on a carousel the co-authors are set on the carousel itself, not on its individual items. Ignored on 'story', which has no co-author concept.

userTags.description: People tagged in the post, up to 20 per photo or video. On a photo (and each photo of a carousel) a tag needs x and y or it is left out; on a Reel or video post people are tagged by username only and any position is ignored. Carousel videos and Stories carry no tags.

username.description: A public Instagram username, leading @ optional.

x.description: Position on the photo, 0 to 1 from the left. Give x and y together or not at all.

y.description: Position on the photo, 0 to 1 from the top.

mediaIndex.description: Which attached media item the tag belongs to, counting from 0 in attachment order (default 0).

shareToFeed.description: Reels only. false shows the Reel only in the Reels tab; true also shows it in the main feed. Omitted: Instagram's own default (feed and Reels tab).

locationId.description: Digits only: the numeric ID of a Facebook Page that has a location. Applies to photos, videos, Reels and carousels, not Stories. Instagram refuses the post if it does not recognise the ID as a place.

trialReel.description: Publish as a trial reel, shown to people who do not follow the account first. Only takes effect with postTypeOverrides.instagram of 'reel' — a 'feed_video' publishes as an ordinary reel and this is ignored, even though both use the same underlying reel container.

graduationStrategy.description: How a trial reel becomes a normal one: 'manual' (the creator releases it) or 'auto' (released automatically if it performs well). Default 'manual'. Ignored unless trialReel is true.

thumbnailTimestamp.description: Cover frame for a video or Reel, in seconds from the start. Applies to postTypeOverrides.instagram of 'feed_video' or 'reel'. Ignored when coverUrl is also set.

coverUrl.description: Cover image URL for a video or Reel. Takes precedence over thumbnailTimestamp: Instagram accepts one or the other and rejects a request carrying both, so only this one is forwarded when both are sent.

repostId.description: With postTypeOverrides.threads = 'repost': the numeric ID of the Threads post to repost (Threads links cannot be used; the ID of a post published through BulkPublish is in get_post's platforms[].platformPostId).

topicTag.description: One topic tag for the post, without a leading '#'. Must not contain periods or ampersands.

locationId.description: Numeric Threads place ID. Only works once the channel has granted location tagging.

replyControl.description: Who can reply (default everyone). parent_post_author_only means only you. Applies to the post itself, never to later replies in a thread; ignored on a repost.

pollOptions.description: 2 to 4 poll choices, each 1 to 25 characters. Text-only posts: on an image, video or carousel post the poll is left out. In a thread it goes on the first part when that part has no media.

linkAttachment.description: An http(s) URL on a public host shown as the preview card on a text post; left out on other post types. Threads refuses a post with more than 5 links in total, and a link here that differs from every link in the text counts as one more.

documentTitle.description: `document` posts only: the title shown above the document in the feed. Defaults to the file's name.

poll.description: Required for `poll` posts, which also need post text and take no media.

options.description: 2 to 4 answers, each up to 30 characters; blank entries are ignored.

reshareId.description: Required for `reshare` posts: the post's LinkedIn link, or its urn:li:share:<id> / urn:li:ugcPost:<id> ID. Activity links (urn:li:activity:<id>) cannot be reshared.

thumbnailUrl.description: Cover for a `post` that carries a video: a public http(s) link to an image of up to 10MB. A cover that cannot be fetched is skipped and LinkedIn picks the frame.

visibility.description: Who can see the post (default PUBLIC). CONNECTIONS applies to personal profiles only; on a Page it is published as PUBLIC.

disableReshare.description: true stops other members resharing the post (default false).

repostId.description: With postTypeOverrides.bluesky = 'repost': the bsky.app post URL (or at:// URI) to repost.

replyAllow.description: Who can reply. Omitted or [] means everyone; otherwise ['nobody'] or any mix of mention, following, follower ('nobody' cannot be combined). Set right after the post publishes; if Bluesky refuses it the post stays published without it. First post of a thread.

allowQuotes.description: false stops other accounts quoting the post (default true). Set right after publishing, like replyAllow.

quoteId.description: The post to quote: a bsky.app post link or an at:// URI (a bare ID is read as one of your own posts). Replaces a link card; with media attached both appear together. Publishing fails before anything is posted if the post cannot be found.

langs.description: Up to 3 language codes such as 'en' or 'pt-BR'. Applies to every part of a thread.

contentLabel.description: Adds a content warning. Applies to every part of a thread.

repostId.description: With postTypeOverrides.mastodon = 'repost': the status URL or ID to boost.

poll.description: Adds a poll. Cannot be combined with media. First post of a thread. A server with tighter limits refuses it at publish time.

expiresIn.description: Seconds the poll stays open, 300 to 2629746.

multiple.description: Voters may pick more than one choice (default false).

hideTotals.description: Hide counts until the poll ends (default false).

sensitive.description: Hides attached media behind a click (default false). No effect without media. Applies to every part of a thread.

quoteId.description: The post to quote: its URL, or its status ID on your own server. Needs a server running Mastodon 4.5 or later, otherwise publishing fails and nothing is posted.

discord.description: Discord options, nested under the BulkPublish channel id: { "12": { "channelId": "1090123456789012345" } }. A flat object applies to every Discord channel on the post. The inner channelId is the target Discord text channel. Posting uses a global bot token, so failures are permission problems, never a reconnect issue.

channelId.description: Required. Target Discord text channel id (a snowflake) inside the connected server. NOT the BulkPublish channel id used as the outer key.

startThread.description: Start a thread from the message (no effect on a forum channel).

threadName.description: Name for that thread, up to 100 characters.

embed.description: Send the text as a rich embed with the first image inside.

poll.description: A native poll. The bot needs the Send Polls permission.

answers.description: 2 to 10 answers, each up to 55 characters.

pin.description: Pin the message. If Discord refuses, the post stays published and a warning is recorded. The bot needs the Pin Messages permission.

tags.description: Up to 5 forum tag IDs (digits) for a forum channel.

telegram.description: Telegram options, nested under the BulkPublish channel id: { "12": { "silent": true } }. A flat object applies to every Telegram channel on the post. The destination chat is fixed when the channel is connected. Content is sent as plain text (no markdown). Text over the 1024-char caption limit is posted as a second message alongside captionless media. Attached GIFs, audio and other files are sent as an animation, an audio file or a document according to their type.

protectContent.description: Recipients cannot forward or save the message.

pin.description: Pin after sending. If the bot lacks the right to pin the post still publishes and a warning is recorded.

threadId.description: Forum topic to post into: digits only, up to 12.

buttons.description: Link buttons under the message, up to 3.

spoiler.description: Hides a photo or video behind a spoiler.

poll.description: Sent as a poll after the message.

options.description: 2 to 12 answers, each up to 100 characters.

multipleAnswers.description: Default false. Cannot be combined with quiz.

correctOption.description: 0-based index of the right answer; required when quiz is true.

buttons.description: Link buttons under the message, up to 3.

spoiler.description: Hides a photo or video behind a spoiler.

poll.description: Sent as a poll after the message.

options.description: 2 to 12 answers, each up to 100 characters.

multipleAnswers.description: Default false. Cannot be combined with quiz.

correctOption.description: 0-based index of the right answer; required when quiz is true.

tumblr.description: Tumblr options, nested under the BulkPublish channel id: { "12": { "blogName": "myblog", "tags": ["art"] } } (tags: array of strings or one comma-separated string). A flat object applies to every Tumblr channel on the post. Up to 30 images OR exactly one video per post.

blogName.description: Which blog to publish to. Defaults to the blog the channel was connected as.

title.description: Rendered as a heading block above the body.

sourceUrl.description: Attribution URL stored as the post's source.

state.description: Default published. A scheduled post with published still goes out at its time; draft and private override that and the post is never made public by BulkPublish.

slug.description: Up to 200 characters; lowercased and hyphenated into the permalink.

reblogUrl.description: A Tumblr post link (tumblr.com/<blog>/<id> or <blog>.tumblr.com/post/<id>): publishes a reblog of that post with your text as the comment.

blogName.description: Which blog to publish to. Defaults to the blog the channel was connected as.

title.description: Rendered as a heading block above the body.

sourceUrl.description: Attribution URL stored as the post's source.

state.description: Default published. A scheduled post with published still goes out at its time; draft and private override that and the post is never made public by BulkPublish.

reblogUrl.description: A Tumblr post link (tumblr.com/<blog>/<id> or <blog>.tumblr.com/post/<id>): publishes a reblog of that post with your text as the comment.

snapchat.description: Snapchat options, nested under the BulkPublish channel id: { "12": { "title": "My story" } }. A flat object applies to every Snapchat channel on the post. Post types: story (default), saved_story, spotlight. Every Snapchat post requires exactly ONE image or video (vertical, story videos 5–60s, spotlight 6–60s video-only, saved_story videos not length-checked, max 1GB; a video outside its range is refused when the post is scheduled or published). The caption is NOT sent for plain stories — it is only the Spotlight description (160 chars max) and the Saved Story title fallback. First comments are not supported.

title.description: Saved Story title (max 45 chars). Defaults to the first line of the caption, truncated.

saveToProfile.description: Spotlight only. Default true; false sends skip_save_to_profile to Snap.

title.description: Saved Story title (max 45 chars). Defaults to the first line of the caption, truncated.

saveToProfile.description: Spotlight only. Default true; false sends skip_save_to_profile to Snap.

requestApproval.description: Optional (default false). Set true to hold a scheduled post for team approval (approvalStatus becomes 'pending'). Forced on server-side for API keys of roles without post:publish (contributors), regardless of this flag.

publishWhenApproved.description: Optional. Set true to have the post go out as soon as it is approved, even after its scheduled time (see create_post). An explicit value is stored while the post waits for approval. Omitted, it is kept, except that sending a different scheduledAt clears it to false, and it is always false once the post is no longer approvalStatus 'pending'.

linkTrackingOverride.description: Optional per-post override for link tracking (bulkpubli.sh). true forces links in this post to be shortened and their clicks counted, false forces them to publish as written, and null clears the override so the post inherits the organization's Link Tracking setting again. Omit to leave it unchanged.

ifUnmodifiedSince.description: Optional precondition: the post's updatedAt exactly as the last read returned it. The update is refused with 409 CONFLICT if a teammate has changed the post since, rather than overwriting their version. Pass it whenever you read a post before editing it; omit it to keep the previous last-write-wins behaviour.

status.description: draft, scheduled, processing, published, partial or failed.

author.description: Who wrote the post: { id, name, image }. Null when that account is gone.

approver.description: Who approved it: { id, name, image }. Null unless approvalStatus is approved.

assignee.description: Who is expected to act on it next: { id, name, image }. Null when nobody is.

tools.name: delete_post
tools.title: Delete post
tools.description: Delete a post by ID. Only draft and failed posts can be deleted. Use this when the user wants to permanently remove a post.

tools.name: get_post_metrics
tools.title: Get post metrics
tools.description: Get engagement metrics for a published post. Returns likes, comments, shares, impressions, and other platform-specific metrics. IMPORTANT: every platform entry carries `metricsSupported` and `supportedMetrics` — a metric key NOT in `supportedMetrics` is stored as 0 because that platform's API has no such field, so report it as unavailable rather than as zero. X reports impressions/likes/comments/shares/saves (bookmarks); Bluesky and Mastodon report no impressions; Pinterest reports no reach; YouTube reports no shares or reach; Discord reports likes (reaction counts) and comments (thread replies); TikTok reports reach, saves and clicks only for accounts that have granted TikTok insights. An Instagram story reports only impressions, reach and comments (story replies). Google Business, Telegram, Tumblr and LinkedIn personal profiles report nothing readable at all, and an X post comes back with `metricsSupported: false` until its channel turns on X metrics sync. Each platform entry also carries `linkClicks` (summed in `totals.linkClicks`): clicks on bulkpubli.sh short links in this post, measured by BulkPublish rather than reported by the platform. It sits OUTSIDE `latest` and is distinct from the platform's own `clicks` — one visit can register in both, so never add them together. It is therefore available even for the platforms that report nothing, and `supportedMetrics` always includes it. Bot and link-preview traffic is excluded; it is 0 for organizations without Link Tracking enabled. Use this when the user asks how a specific post performed (likes, views, engagement).

postId.description: The post ID to get metrics for.

tools.name: get_queue_slot
tools.title: Get next queue slot
tools.description: Get the organization's next available queue slot. Useful for finding the next optimal scheduling time. Use this when the user asks when the next available scheduling slot is, or wants a post moved to the top or bottom of the queue (then update_post with the returned scheduledAt).

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the slot calculation (e.g. "America/New_York"). Defaults to UTC.

position.description: "next" (default): the next free slot. "end": the slot after the last pending scheduled post, i.e. the bottom of the queue.

excludePostId.description: When the slot is for rescheduling an existing post, its ID — so its current slot is not counted as booked.

scheduledAt.description: ISO timestamp of the next free slot.

tools.name: compose_post
tools.title: Compose a post
tools.description: Open an interactive composer to draft or schedule a social media post. Shows the user's connected channels to pick from and pre-fills any provided text. The user finishes in the UI; on submit it creates the post via create_post. Use this when the user wants to compose a post interactively in a UI — prefer this over create_post when they'd review before posting.

content.description: Optional initial text to pre-fill the composer with.

tools.name: view_analytics
tools.title: Analytics dashboard
tools.description: Open an interactive analytics dashboard for a date range — totals, status breakdown, per-platform stats, and daily post counts. Use this when the user wants an interactive analytics dashboard — prefer over get_analytics for a visual view.

from.description: Start date (ISO, e.g. 2025-01-01). Defaults to 30 days ago.

tools.name: view_posts
tools.title: Posts
tools.description: Open an interactive list of posts with their status, schedule, and channels. Optionally filter by status. Use this when the user wants to see their posts as an interactive dashboard — prefer over list_posts for a visual view.

tools.name: view_channels
tools.title: Channels
tools.description: Open an interactive view of connected social channels with platform, account, and connection/token status. Use this when the user wants an interactive view of their connected channels.

tools.name: view_media
tools.title: Media library
tools.description: Open an interactive gallery of uploaded media files with thumbnails and metadata. Use this when the user wants to browse their media library visually.

tools.name: create_media_upload
tools.title: Start media upload
tools.description: Reserve a presigned upload URL for a direct browser upload (used by the composer UI). For scripted uploads use upload_media instead. Use this when you need a presigned URL for a large direct upload (advanced; prefer upload_media for normal files).

contentType.description: File MIME type, e.g. image/png or video/mp4.

tools.name: finalize_media_upload
tools.title: Finalize media upload
tools.description: Record an uploaded file as a media file after the browser PUT (pairs with create_media_upload; used by the composer UI). Use this when a presigned direct upload finished and the file must be registered (advanced).
